ahmadhcj07: They issued Bram Ahmadhcj a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lock of hair in a matchbox in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Bram Ahmadhcj was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F11. Bram Ahmadhcj has learned to walk bent double.

Bram Ahmadhcj fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bram Satalik, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A shell burst over R-F11 and threw Bram Ahmadhcj into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post.
Bram Ahmadhcj was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.
Bram Ahmadhcj wore a fresh bandage at R-F11 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Bram Ahmadhcj wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A bullet found Bram Ahmadhcj at R-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). Bram Ahmadhcj spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
There was no room for Bram Ahmadhcj. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.

Another member of the House of Ahmadhcj reached the line: Edmund Ahmadhcj. He asked where Bram Ahmadhcj had slept, then chose a different corner. Edmund Ahmadhcj, volunteer number 32, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Rumour reached R-F11 that the war would be over by spring. Edmund Ahmadhcj has heard it before. So has everyone.
Edmund Ahmadhcj got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Edmund Ahmadhcj only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F11, then nothing but pain. Raider: Isidor Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141). Edmund Ahmadhcj walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Edmund Ahmadhcj returned to R-F11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
aklouisza: Nobody asked Jakub Aklouisza why he came. Nobody in S-S7 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Jakub Aklouisza went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Jakub Aklouisza asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Jakub Aklouisza was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Jakub Aklouisza stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Aklouisza watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Jakub Aklouisza had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Quentin "Hollow" Diboo crossed it, Jakub Aklouisza fired. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jakub Aklouisza is number 404. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
cloggedlog6969: On Day 11 Quentin Cloggedlog took a post at N-F11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.
dougdouglas21: At the depot, Viktor Dougdouglas had practised answering to his name. At U-F2, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A loose thread in Viktor Dougdouglas's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
gadost144hd: After 11 days of war, V-F9 had a place for everything. On Day 11, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Bram Gadost.
ian_bmx_51: On Day 9, Cyril Bmx arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Cyril Bmx did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Cyril Bmx fired back. Tobias Jacckk was grazed. Cyril Bmx walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Cyril Bmx sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. The clerk counted the names twice. Cyril Bmx is number 877 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
jester.404: Roland Jester came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Roland Jester. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home found Roland Jester before the night shift. Roland Jester folded it small and kept it close.
realjospence: Bastian Realjospence, a glassblower from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in U-F21. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
A flare caught Bastian Realjospence halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
tomvandeloosdrecht: Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
tylen7x: Yann "Smokes" Tylen joined the replacements on Day 6. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. Yann "Smokes" Tylen's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.
Yann "Smokes" Tylen's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Yann "Smokes" Tylen listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

An officer asked who was writing the menus. Yann "Smokes" Tylen admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home. Yann "Smokes" Tylen got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 407. The men who came later will ask about it.
